stats.label: Spotify monthly listeners
stats._comment: CORRECTED 2026-07: previously read '50K+ Spotify listeners'. The real figure is ~9,000 monthly listeners. Talent buyers and press cross-check Spotify for Artists numbers, and an inflated stat on an EPK is the fastest way to lose a booking. If the intent was cumulative streams rather than monthly listeners, reframe the tile explicitly (e.g. '2M+ streams') rather than restoring the old wording.

bio:
Juliana Beltran is a Colombian singer-songwriter and performer based in Los Angeles. Her sound blends Latin pop, indie pop, and singer-songwriter storytelling — intimate yet commanding, equally at home in a 200-cap room or a festival stage.

A touring vocalist for international artist Amanda Miguel and a featured artist on Spotify editorial playlists, Juliana brings stage presence, vocal power, and genuine connection to every performance.

Available for live shows, festivals, private events, and collaborations.
